intent.goal: Prepare DynamoDB agent session state and configure Lambda idempotency for retries

candidates.route_summary: Prepare DynamoDB API requests for agent session state, optional status index, item expiration, point in time recovery and change streams.
candidates.supported_boundary: Offline request planning for a new DynamoDB agent/session table using string keys, on-demand billing and AWS managed KMS, with separately selected status index, TTL, recovery and streams. candidates.route_summary: Configure Python Lambda Powertools DynamoDB idempotency to deduplicate completed retries, reject changed payment payloads and reason about uncertain external side effects.
candidates.supported_boundary: Guidance and tested Python 3.12/Powertools 3.36.0 wiring for a single decoded JSON payment event per Lambda invocation and an existing DynamoDB persistence table. Requires a buyer-supplied payment function with durable downstream idempotency. Does not implement a payment processor, cross-service atomicity, authentication, SQS batch handling, AWS deployment or other language adapters.
